_about: Arthur Sidgwick (1840-1920), Fellow and Tutor of Corpus Christi College, Oxford, later Reader in Greek at Oxford; brother of Henry Sidgwick: school and college editions with English introductions and notes, raw IA. Aeschylus for the Clarendon Press Series: Agamemnon (3rd ed. revised, 1887), Choephoroi (1884), Eumenides vol. I, introduction and text (1887; the notes volume was not found on IA), Septem contra Thebas (1903). Virgil, P. Vergili Maronis Opera with introduction and English notes (Cambridge: University Press), vol. I introduction and text (1897 printing) and vol. II notes (1899 printing; first edition 1890, reprinted 1894). Greek and Latin text editions kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Not taken: his Persae (1903; persae01aesc OCRs as Greek letters throughout, clean 0.000); The Influence of Greek Philosophy on English Poetry (1906), which is by Arthur H. Sidgwick, his son. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dt). No uids minted.
